user.title: PowerShades
user.description:
Enter your PowerShades **RF gateway** address (local, e.g. `10.0.30.239`).

**Base travel time** = how many seconds a shade takes to move fully open to fully closed. It's a starting point — you'll refine it per shade in the next step (taller shades are slower). Used to emulate "set to N%", which the gateway itself can't do (only up/down/stop). Default 20s.

channel.title: Identifying channel {n} of {m}
channel.description:
This is a linked channel. Pick **Up** or **Down** and tap **Next** to nudge that physical shade — watch which window moves.

Do this as many times as you need to find it. When you've matched it, type a **name** and its **travel time** (seconds, how long it actually takes), tick **Move on to next**, then Next.

Leave name/travel blank to skip them.

data.name: Name (optional)
data.travel_time: Travel time for THIS shade, seconds (optional)
data.advance: I'm done with this shade — move on to the next

groups.title: Groups (optional)
groups.description:
Group channels so they open / close together. One group per **line**, format `Name: 1,2,3`.

Example:
```
Great Room: 1,2,3
Office: 4,5
```

Leave blank for no groups.

error.gateway_unreachable: Could not reach the RF gateway. Check the address / network.
error.no_shades: Gateway is reachable but no channels report a shade linked. Link one in the gateway UI first.

init.title: PowerShades options
init.description:
Update the **base** travel time, per-shade travel times, names, and groups — without re-adding the integration.

Travel-time and name lines: `channel=value` per line (travel in seconds).
Groups: `Name: 1,2,3` per line.

Leave any of them blank to leave them unchanged.
